text: Databases store and organize information so we can find it quickly. In relational databases, data lives in tables with rows and columns, and we use SQL to write queries that retrieve or change it. NoSQL databases, by contrast, store data differently, often as documents, and suit flexible or huge datasets. Good data modeling helps you plan the structure before building it. Indexes make searches much faster, but they also take extra space, so use them wisely. Choosing the right type depends on your needs.
